MY JOURNEY

Raised across West Africa, self-taught from scratch, and building software that real businesses can actually run on.

BACKGROUND
Where I'm From

I was born in Togo and raised mostly in Nigeria, but my life has never stayed inside one border. I live close to where Togo, Ghana and Burkina Faso meet, so crossing into Benin to see family or into Ghana to see friends is a normal part of my year, not a trip I plan months ahead for. Moving between places and languages early on taught me to adapt fast and read a situation before reacting to it, a habit that carried straight into how I work today.

HANDS-ON START
Learning the Trade

Right now I'm based in Saki, Oyo State, Nigeria, learning fashion design and monogram machine embroidery, and working as a tailor with real customers while I learn, not just practicing on scraps. I'd be the first person in my town doing machine embroidery and earning from it, which means figuring out a lot of the workflow myself: measurements, back-and-forth with customers, keeping orders straight. That firsthand friction is exactly what shows up in projects like AtelierFit and StitchBook on this site. I'm not guessing what a tailor needs, I live it.

AI Outreach is a single-user tool built for my own client outreach, not a product for other people to use. It finds local businesses, audits their websites, and drafts a personalised email for each one, which I review and send myself. Nothing goes out automatically.

Leads come from a pasted website, a CSV import, or a city-and-category search against OpenStreetMap, with no API key needed. The audit fetches each homepage, respects robots.txt, and records real signals: a missing meta description, no mobile viewport, images without alt text, the CMS in use, contact details and social links. Drafting is one Gemini call per lead, grounded only in that lead's actual evidence, and if a draft fails the lead is marked with the real error rather than filled with generic text. Every draft is editable, shows the evidence behind it, and has to be approved before anything is sent from my own mail app. A permanent registry keyed by domain means the same business is never drafted twice, and a do-not-contact list is checked before every draft.

AI OUTREACH
OVERVIEW PITCH

A private tool I use to find local businesses with weak websites, audit their sites and draft personalised outreach emails with Gemini, which I review and send myself. Password-protected and hosted on Render.

PROJECT STORY & DETAILS
AI Outreach is a single-user tool built for my own client outreach, not a product for other people to use. It finds local businesses, audits their websites, and drafts a personalised email for each one, which I review and send myself. Nothing goes out automatically.

Leads come from a pasted website, a CSV import, or a city-and-category search against OpenStreetMap, with no API key needed. The audit fetches each homepage, respects robots.txt, and records real signals: a missing meta description, no mobile viewport, images without alt text, the CMS in use, contact details and social links. Drafting is one Gemini call per lead, grounded only in that lead's actual evidence, and if a draft fails the lead is marked with the real error rather than filled with generic text. Every draft is editable, shows the evidence behind it, and has to be approved before anything is sent from my own mail app. A permanent registry keyed by domain means the same business is never drafted twice, and a do-not-contact list is checked before every draft.

Security: the whole app sits behind password login with signed, HttpOnly session cookies

Size guide

Every bespoke garment is cut to your own measurements, taken or confirmed at your fitting. If you would like to prepare, or you are ordering from abroad, these notes explain how to measure.

How to measure

Use a soft tape measure, wear light clothing, and ask someone to help. Keep the tape snug but not tight.

Neck
Around the base of the neck, where a shirt collar sits. Keep one finger between the tape and the neck.
Chest
Around the fullest part of the chest, under the arms, with the tape level across the back.
Waist
Around the natural waistline, just above the navel. Breathe normally and do not hold in.
Hips
Around the fullest part of the hips and seat, feet together.
Shoulder width
Across the back, from the edge of one shoulder bone to the other.
Sleeve length
From the shoulder edge, over a slightly bent elbow, to the wrist bone.
Inside leg
From the crotch seam down the inside of the leg to where you want the trouser to finish.
Height
Standing straight against a wall, without shoes.
Ready-to-wear sizes

An indicative guide in centimetres. Agbada are cut generously; if you are between sizes, choose the smaller.

Privacy policy

This policy explains how Voltway Electrical ("we") collects and uses personal information when you contact us or request a quote.

What we collect

When you send a quote request we collect your name, email address and the details you give us about the job. If you call or email us, we keep a record of that conversation.

How we use it

We use your information only to respond to your enquiry, prepare quotes, carry out and certify work, and keep the records we are legally required to keep. We do not sell your information or use it for unrelated marketing.

How long we keep it

Enquiries that do not lead to work are deleted after 12 months. Records of completed work and certificates are kept for as long as required by building regulations and tax law.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law you can ask to see, correct or delete the information we hold about you, or object to how we use it. Contact us at hello@voltway.example. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).
